values.summary: Implemented the bounded durable serving-authority foundation with exact sealed #203 receipt bindings, byte-exact canonical preimage validation, checkpointed Pending-to-Reconciled-to-Published recovery, bounded retry/capacity rules, and deterministic redacted projection. Focused product proof and exact-target strict Clippy are green; broad all-target strict Clippy remains baseline-red only in unrelated pre-existing Runtime test surfaces and is not claimed green.
actual_changes: Registered the new serving_authority module without changing #203 or parent #205 behavior.
Added exact direct adapter/receipt binding plus DOMAIN-NUL, u32 big-endian length, RFC8785 JCS, fixed-field, size, digest, identity, and prior-state validation.
Added checkpointed durable Pending, Reconciled, and Published transitions with restart continuation, exact retry, conflict, corruption, capacity, and path-safety denial.
Added deterministic redacted projection and focused integration proof covering five behavioral tests.
